name: DNS C2 Kill Chain — NXDOMAIN Storm + Outbound Firewall Activity
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome_reason = "NXDOMAIN"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| bin _time span = 60m
| comp count() as nxd_count by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter nxd_count >= 20
| join (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "302014"
    | alter int_host  = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
            int_iface = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface
    | filter int_iface = "inside"
    | comp count() as outbound_sessions by int_host
    | filter outbound_sessions >= 1
  ) as fw xdm.source.ipv4 = fw.int_host
| fields int_host
description: Internal host with NXDOMAIN storm AND outbound TCP traffic from same IP.
alert_name: DNS C2 Kill Chain — NXDOMAIN Storm + Outbound Firewall Activity
